state.question: These numbered clips are shuffled segments from one cooking video. Determine their chronological order. Return only clip numbers joined by ->.
state.summary: v5 shows eggs cracked and cream added, so it is first. v3 shows active whisking in the white bowl with butter and cheese staged, placing it after v5. v4 shows a uniform pale yellow liquid with eggshells and butter, indicating post-whisking and before pan pouring. v2 shows whisking, butter melting, and pouring the yellow mixture into the pan, so it follows v4. v1 shows cheese grated into the pan mixture and thickening, so it is last.

events.description: A person uses a handheld grater to grate parmesan cheese directly into a pan containing a yellow liquid mixture.
The mixture in the pan has thickened significantly into a solid, creamy mass, which is being stirred and folded with a wooden spatula.
Whisking a yellow mixture in a bowl. Placing a knob of butter into a pan. Adding sea salt flakes to the pan.
Butter knob sitting in the pan with salt flakes visible.
Whisking the yellow mixture while the butter sits in the pan.
The butter begins to melt in the pan; the bowl sits beside it.
Person speaking, then holding a wooden spoon while the butter melts.
Swirling the pan to coat the bottom with melted butter.
Pouring the yellow mixture into the pan.
Holding the pan handle while the mixture cooks.
A person holds a frying pan containing a thin, pale yellow crepe or omelet base, swirling it to cook evenly.
A close-up view shows the surface of the cooking crepe, which now has a textured, bubbly appearance.
